fields.note: The water-ballast bladder is charged at 2 % of capacity; pillow-tank listings give 0.35-0.93 % for the fabric of 1,500-10,000 L ground tanks, not flight hardware. Capacity is the cold-day excess lift: 322-536 kg at R10 and 13.9-19.7 t at R30 for the widest bands. Refill is at the mooring; drain control and load paths are not designed. The dump is needed only to hold altitude at fixed payload; a variable payload can absorb the excess.
